population_rule.spacing_within_a_type: with k firms of a type, the j-th (j = 0 .. k-1, in id order) gets min + j * (max - min) / (k - 1); with k = 1 it gets the midpoint (min + max) / 2. Capital is rounded half up to an integer; capability is rounded to 6 decimals
